annotations.title: Recent resets, promotions and limit changes

description: List recent events for AI coding tools, newest first, each with its official source link: usage-limit resets, promotions and free credits, limit increases or decreases, and discontinued plans. Optionally filter by tool and by group.

group.description: Only events of this group: resets (usage-limit resets), deals (promotions and free credits), limits (limit increases or decreases), discontinued (discontinued tools or plans). Omit for all groups.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return, 1 to 50. Default 10.

tool.description: Only events of this AI coding tool. Omit for all tools. One of: codex, claude-code, cursor, gemini-cli, copilot, kiro, windsurf, antigravity.

name: list_events

alerts_url.description: Where to get an alert when the tool (or any tool) resets next: free, no account
